products.name: Flat white
products.description: Purportedly invented for customers wanting a milky coffee drink that had less foam than a cappuccino. It’s made from a shot or double shot of espresso topped with steamed, slightly foamy milk. This makes for a velvety, smooth cup with a bold coffee flavour.
